## Description

Mic button on a note section: the doctor dictates (no patient consent needed when only the doctor speaks, policy-configurable), transcription fills that section as an AI-draft field requiring accept/edit before signing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Dictated text appears as "AI draft · not reviewed" and must be accepted or edited.
- [ ] **AC2.** Dictation audio follows the same retention policy and is never mixed with the consultation recording.
- [ ] **AC3.** Works on desktop and mobile web.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
